_description: Expiry markdown policy — approved by Leke 2026-07-17. Used by reconcile_published.py. Tiers: days-to-expiry thresholds (inclusive upper bound) mapped to markdown fraction. Floor: Shopify price never drops below the item's purchase_rate (cost); floored items are flagged for disposal review. Prices round to the nearest rounding_step naira. Expired items are pulled to DRAFT on Shopify and listed for disposal.
